claim_being_audited: The current release can be certified because it passes aggregate launch readiness and rehearsal severity thresholds, provided the current model card reflects the current evaluation batch and explicitly discloses the clinical coding assistant regression; prior approval and informal monitoring are only contextual support.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if the material segment weakness for the named launch use case is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness passage and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness context but do not by themselves satisfy the model-card disclosure policy.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may inform context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation batch results.
Provide the exact disclosure language for the clinical coding assistant regression in the current model card.
If disclosure was not made, provide the approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering this named launch use case before launch.
Provide any approval record tying the current retrieval configuration and current eval batch to the certification decision.
specific_concerns: No admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation or model card actually reflects the current evaluation results.
No admissible evidence shows that the clinical coding assistant regression has actually been disclosed in the current model card.
Policy requires current disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations in named launch use cases; the packet identifies this requirement but does not supply proof it was satisfied.
The informal manual monitoring comment is expressly not attached as reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language, so it cannot close the policy gap.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot substantiate certification of the present release.
unsupported_claims: The packet's assertion that certification is supportable on the present record is not fully supported because the required current disclosure artifact is missing from admissible evidence.
The packet summary's reference to a current model-card update is unsupported by the raw evidence provided.
